create.placeholderPolicy: Not an executable payload. Use byte-bound original private body only after separate execution approval; never send placeholders.

files.source: Original verified dist file bytes, or original netlify.toml; path omits dist/.

functions.source: Original verified .netlify/functions/{name}.zip; only initial required_functions digests.

uploads.selection: Only exact initial-create required/required_functions arrays; reject missing or malformed lists, unknown/duplicate/nonunique digest mappings and nonempty server/edge requirements. Retain initial lists before optional-field checks. Never reconstruct queues from later GET.
uploads.receiptPolicy: HTTP200 and exact SHA plus original path/length for files or name/SHA for Functions. File paths accept only the exact original path or that same path with one leading slash. No percent-decoding, case/prefix folding, guessed identity or silent field defaults.

preconditions: Separate exact A-D owner execution approval
Fresh exact target, unpublished primary baseline, deploy inventory, Git/domain/build-settings and site/shared environment metadata
Independent dashboard Private production and previews/team login all-deploys
Frozen bytes, sealed original value custody and original request/Function metadata match
Reviewed new executor with durable pre-send/initial-response evidence and offline stop/UNKNOWN tests; no historical mutator reuse
No credential retrieval or hosted Auth/database operations under this review

verification.expected: New ready unpublished manual preview; nine exact static paths/digests/lengths and four exact Function registrations/metadata; original and primary baselines unchanged; no domain or alias settings change. The new immutable permalink is expected, not an alias-setting mutation.
verification.anonymousPerimeter: Existing 27 paths, GET/HEAD without cookie/Authorization, no redirect following; no app/file/API bytes;404 alone is inconclusive. No sign-in or Function-runtime acceptance under A-D.
verification.runtimeEnvironment: Original request integrity/custody verified offline. Effective provider/runtime values remain unverified; no secret-reading/debug endpoint or compensating config update.
verification.draftFieldOmitted: Retain arrays first. Permit only predeclared independent site-scoped read confirming exact new ID/site/manual deploy-preview/null publication/expected HTTPS immutable permalink and unchanged primary; false or contradictory evidence stops. No request replay.

forbidden: Final manifest PUT or any old-deploy mutation
Automatic retry, new replacement ID or restart after UNKNOWN
Build, current-HEAD substitution or new source checkout
Publication, deletion, cancellation, restore, domain/alias changes, Git link/build hook
Provider or financial execution, sending messages, outside access, merge
authority: A-D proposal only. No mutation executed or execution permission inferred. Release1.0 NOT READY / NOT AUTHORIZED.
